    If you're travelling for work, your luggage needs to hustle as hard as you do. Look for dedicated slots for your laptop, crucial documents, and chargers, plus a sharp, professional vibe. Mokobara's Transit series and the Cabin Overnighter nail this mix of practical organisation and sleek looks.
    The right luggage size depends on the duration and type of your trip. For weekend getaways, a compact and small trolley bag like the Transit Cabin is perfect, while longer trips may require large trolley bags like the Check-in Large. Mokobara’s collection scales to fit both short and extended journeys comfortably.
    Any solid luggage trolley absolutely needs buttery smooth-gliding wheels, a sturdy telescopic handle, and an interior that actually helps you organise. Mokobara’s luggage trolley bags, like the Check-in Large or the Transit Cabin, pack all these features to make transits way less stressful and way more fun.
    100%. Front-opening luggage bags give you a massive cheat code for airport security: instant access to your laptop, passport, and chargers without exposing your packed underwear to the whole terminal. Mokobara’s Transit and Em Access lines rock these front-loading compartments to keep you moving fast and organised.
    We obsess over the details. Mokobara luggage isn't just about looking incredibly good (though it definitely does). It’s about practical organisation and effortless movement. Between the silent wheels, the perfectly balanced handles, and the hyper-focus on solving real travel friction, Mokobara is quite literally built for modern folks who crave simplicity on the road.
    Mokobara luggage is built to last, with high-quality materials and a durable construction. We offer a 6-year warranty on select models and a 30-day trial, so you can travel with confidence, knowing your luggage is ready to withstand countless adventures.
    Cabin luggage trolleys from Mokobara are sized perfectly in accordance with major Indian airlines, including IndiGo, Air India, and SpiceJet. But that doesn’t mean you’re getting a small trolley bag; you can still pack for 3-5 days in our cabin bags.
    Mokobara’s luggage trolley bags are crafted with German Makrolon Polycarbonate hard shell that makes them resistant to airport tossing and tumbling. Choosing an unbreakable yet lightweight material like ours ensures your belongings stay safe without exceeding the weight limits.
    Yes, travelling bags offered by Mokobara come with keyless TSA-approved locks that can be opened by the airport security agents using a universal master key without breaking your suitcase.
    It depends on your travel and packing needs. However, luggage sets do offer better value compared to a solo trolley suitcase. Moreover, you can store your medium and small trolley bags within the large trolley bags.
    Mokobara luggage is worth every single rupee you spend on it because it offers a premium aesthetic, a thoughtful design that solves modern travel problems, an impeccable internal organisation system, and a worry-free warranty of up to 6 years.

    Your Perfect Travel Companion Awaits

    Exploring the world hits different when you aren't fighting with your gear. Honestly, your choice of luggage makes or breaks a trip. Sure, trolley bags come in various sizes and materials, made for totally different travel styles. But here at Mokobara, we built a collection of trolley suitcases around one simple philosophy: not too much, not too little, just exactly right. We just want to bring back the sheer joy of travel for modern folks who are out there truly #GoingPlaces.

    Designed with Purpose, Built for Movement

    ​We don't see our luggage trolley bags as mere containers for your stuff. Think of them as hyper-engineered travel sidekicks. Take the Transit series. It totally flips the traditional luggage trolley concept on its head with a front-opening design, so you get instant access to your essentials without spilling all your packed clothes everywhere.

    ​Earning our spot as one of the best luggage brands in India means we actually pay attention to the real headaches travellers face. Just look at our cabin luggage trolleys, for example. We gave the Cabin Overnighter an incredibly handy front compartment so your laptop and boarding passes stay within arm's reach from check-in to touchdown. 

    On the flip side, the Aisle Trunk brings super clean aesthetics paired with hardcore functionality, mainly because we strongly believe the best trips don't involve wrestling with complicated gear. The best part? You can choose the Aisle Trunk you love in three different sizes: trolley bag small size, trolley bag medium size, or trolley bag large size. 

    Luggage Trolley Bags for Every Journey

    ​Planning a quick weekend hop with the compact Transit Cabin? Or maybe a month-long escapade with our Check-in Large? Either way, each of our travelling bags scales up or down to fit exactly what you're doing. We obsess over the details in every single design. We're talking smooth-gliding wheels that breeze through chaotic airport terminals, telescopic handles dialled in perfectly for your walking stride, and interiors mapped out to squeeze the absolute most out of every cubic centimetre. 

    ​Going from large trolley bags right down to tiny suitcases, our trolley suitcases are sized and styled for basically any adventure. Escaping to the hills for a couple of days? Just grab a small trolley bag like our Cabin Overnighter Luggage. Toss your gear in its quick-access front tech pocket, rely on that roomy 41-litre capacity, and suddenly your work-from-the-mountains plan is completely sorted. 

    Got a full week of vacation blocked out? You'll want to check out our medium trolley bags. Something like the Transit Wave literally has it all, from TSA-approved locks down to spill-proof pockets. Then there are those massive, month-long international haul trips. That's where our Access Trunk Luggage steps in and absolutely dominates the trolley bags large size category.

    When you buy luggage & trolley bags online from Mokobara, you aren't just getting trolley bags with wheels. You're getting designs built around how people actually move. Take the Em Access series. Its front-loading compartments mean your must-haves are always right there. Or look at the Transit collection, which strips things back to clean lines and purposeful organisation. Oh, and we didn't forget the kids. For the 3-to-8-year-old crowd, our Moko Blocks make for the ultimate trolley bag, small size on the outside but packed with absolute wonder. 

    Why Choose Mokobara When You Buy Luggage

    ​At the end of the day, what really sets the best luggage brands apart isn't just how tough the bags are. It's the insanely thoughtful design that actively makes travelling better. Hit checkout and buy a luggage bag online from our collection, and here's what you're actually investing in:

    1. Intuitive organisation that practically cures travel anxiety

    We refuse to make trolley bags that are just giant, empty boxes for you to cram your luggage into. It doesn't matter if you go for our cabin luggage trolleys or the massive check-in suitcases. Every single one is kitted out with an internal organisation system to keep your clothes flat, your tech snug in its own zone, and your essentials sliding right into quick-access pockets.

    2. Clean aesthetics that actually turn heads 

    Let's face it, your travelling bag does a lot of talking for you before you even say hello. Rolling up with a Mokobara means making a bad first impression is completely off the table. The moment you stroll through the terminal with one of our trolley bags with wheels gliding along like absolute butter, your whole stride just oozes effortless style and confidence. 

    3. Smart features fixing real-world travel headaches 

    Say goodbye to hoarding cheap ziplock bags for toiletries, frantic digging for a phone charger, or hunting down tiny padlocks to secure your luggage. Those annoying little rituals vanish completely when you upgrade to our travel trolley bags. We specifically designed these to overhaul and drastically improve the way you pack, navigate through crowded airports, and finally unpack. 

    4. The signature Mokobara quality promise 

    Yeah, our trolley bag price might lean a bit more premium than the run-of-the-mill options out there. But honestly? Our trolley bags pack in way more genuine value than even some of the best luggage brands. Most of our luggage & trolley bags are backed by a totally worry-free warranty stretching up to 6 years. We are so fiercely confident you'll be obsessed with your new Mokobara companion that we throw in a 30-day trial. We genuinely just want you to find your absolute perfect travel match.

    Join the Movement

    ​The whole world is out there waiting, and your new Mokobara luggage is totally primed to tag along. Buying luggage bags from our collection means you're doing way more than just checking off a packing list; you're actively buying into a vastly better way to travel. 

    ​Are you ready to completely rewrite your travel rules?     #GoingPlaces

    We believe humans are like sharks. They have to keep moving to thrive. To grow. To feel alive.

    As long as they have a destination in mind - whether it’s a life goal, career aim or even a trip - they have a purpose in life. They’re #GoingPlaces.

    We’re on a mission to help folks who are #GoingPlaces, travel with ease & get there looking sharp. We believe every trip starts the minute you have a destination in mind, not when you get there. You should be focused on your destination, not fretting over how to get there.

    Every little thing in your Mokobara is thoughtfully designed to make travel easier for you. Mokobara is here to give you the freedom to go places - To near places, far places, anywhere but here places.
